android.desc: N Calendar is a simple calendar app, daily planner and schedule organizer for work, family and school. Plan your day, set reminders and color-code your schedule — all in one free agenda planner. No account or sign-up needed: just download, open and start planning your schedule right away. ■ A calendar app that works offline, out of the box This planner works as a standalone offline calendar. No Google account, no sync setup — your schedule stays on your device, protected by an optional passcode lock. There is no event sharing and no automatic cloud sync: these features are left out on purpose, so your calendar stays simple and private. ■ Effortless daily planning Add events and notes with one tap. Set reminders and alarms so you never miss a meeting, deadline, appointment or birthday. Save time with event templates and input history. ■ Monthly, weekly & daily planner views Switch between the monthly calendar for long-term planning, the weekly planner for your week at a glance, and the daily agenda for detailed time planning. The weekly view can show 7, 5 or 3 days to match your routine. ■ Smart features to keep you organized ✓ Reminders & alarms — stay ahead of every deadline ✓ Color coding — see work, family and personal events at a glance ✓ Calendar widget — check today's agenda right on your home screen ✓ 46 theme colors & 10 font sizes — make the planner truly yours ✓ Dark theme colors — easy on your eyes at night ✓ Passcode lock — keep your schedule private ✓ Notes, URLs and locations — attach details to any event ■ One planner for every part of your life ✓ Work schedule & business calendar — meetings, projects and busy days ✓ Student planner — classes, homework, assignments and exams ✓ Family organizer — school events, chores and family time ✓ Appointment book — doctor visits and personal appointments ✓ Holiday & travel planner — trips and celebrations in one place ■ Backup and restore made simple Switching to a new phone? Back up your calendar to Google Drive, or export your data by email or to your device, and restore it easily — your schedule stays with you. ■ Simple, fast and free A free calendar planner with a clean, intuitive design anyone can use. Time blocking, color-coded schedules and flexible calendar views give you a clear overview of your time. An optional Premium Service subscription removes ads for a distraction-free experience. ■ Pricing

quotes.text:
I'm assuming you're looking for the monthly planner view that actually shows events and not just indicators? Try calendar widgets suite or business calendar 2 planner. Unfortunately both are ad-supported (anything designed explicitly to show local personal information shouldn't go online IMHO), but there's a paid version as well. There's a couple other apps that have similar looking widgets as well, you might find more by searching for monthly planner widgets, not calendar widgets. It might also be possible to find one using a week toolkit (I used Zooper in the past, but I think it's pretty dead now; not sure what's replaced it).
